[IDSP.7.2] Forms — `cache-get` is a value-returning read
(expression position), served **from the engine's own
in-engine cache map** ([LSTO.4.7], no callback);
`cache-set` / `cache-delete` are statement actions
(`ds_dispatcher_cache_set` / `ds_dispatcher_cache_delete`)
that mutate the engine's cache and optionally persist it:

```
cache-get(key)                      → JSON-text on hit, null on miss
cache-set(key, value-json, ttl-ns)  ; ttl-ns 0 = no expiry
cache-delete(key)
```
